subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should `agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars`, `agents.defaults.bootstrapTotalMaxChars`, and their per-agent overrides be allowed through the model-facing Gateway `config.apply`/`config.patch` tool?
rationale: The fields are documented runtime tuning knobs, but the Gateway tool allowlist is an explicit model-to-operator security boundary, so expanding it should reflect maintainer intent rather than an automatic cleanup decision.

options.title: Allow bootstrap budget tuning
options.body: Treat these fields like nearby low-risk agent runtime tuning and unblock them with focused guard and restart-persistence coverage.

options.title: Keep tool writes blocked
options.body: Preserve the current boundary and update docs/UI to make clear that these fields must be edited outside model-facing Gateway config tools.

recommendation.title: Allow bootstrap budget tuning
recommendation.body: Treat these fields like nearby low-risk agent runtime tuning and unblock them with focused guard and restart-persistence coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent targeted history on the config guard path is commit 29f206243b, which makes this the best available routing owner for the allowlist decision.
